title: More control over Seedream and Seedance
summary:
Seedream and Seedance gained clearer model choices, audio and prompt requests got more predictable, and thirteen community projects joined the directory.

Seedream and Seedance gained separate standard and pro choices. `seedream` selects Seedream 4.0, while `seedream-pro` selects 4.5 with 4K and multi-image support. For video, `seedance` selects Lite and `seedance-pro` selects Pro-Fast; both support text-to-video and image-to-video. Seedance usage is now represented in video tokens across model listings, usage headers and Enter pricing.

Simple GET text requests now recognize audio-output models and request audio, fixing 400 responses for models such as `openai-audio`. That model's input limit was reduced to 2,500 characters and its completion limit to 512 tokens. Errors point to Enter for full audio capabilities, and the auth page notes a planned move by Dec. 8.

Thirteen community projects joined the directories, spanning line art, video creation, social posting, note-taking, chat, Telegram characters, waste identification and a Godville browser extension. The Projects page submission button was also corrected to open the current app-submission template.

highlights.title: Two Seedream choices
highlights.text: Choose `seedream` for Seedream 4.0, or `seedream-pro` for 4.5 with 4K and multi-image support. [Explore Seedream Pro](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream-pro).

highlights.title: Seedance Lite or Pro
highlights.text: Generate from text or images with `seedance` for Lite or `seedance-pro` for Pro-Fast. Both default to 720p and five seconds, with a ten-second maximum. [Explore Seedance Pro](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedance-pro).
